dedupe_keys.name: whu stree multi modal benchmark dataset for street tree inventory nanjing and shenyang

description: WHU-STree is a benchmark dataset for automating street tree inventories from mobile mapping, with synchronised point clouds and high-resolution panoramic images collected along roads in two Chinese cities, Nanjing and Shenyang. It has 21,007 annotated tree instances covering 50 species and two morphological parameters, and supports more than ten tasks such as individual tree segmentation, species classification and parameter estimation. A team led by Wuhan University with the Technical University of Munich, the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology and China Agricultural University released it with a 2026 paper in the ISPRS Journal of Photogrammetry and Remote Sensing; the Nanjing subset was used in China LiDAR Conference competitions in 2025 and 2026, and corrected trajectories were added in July 2026. Coverage is road corridors in the two cities. Format and access: folders per road with trajectory CSV files, JPEG panoramas and PLY point clouds, available after a data request form. Licence: not stated; free. Caveats: download links have changed several times, and it is a research benchmark, not a municipal inventory. It supports digital twins of urban trees for climate adaptation, such as wind and heat risk. Related catalogue records are the NYC 2015 Street Tree Census and the Tongji street tree wind fragility model.
